title: withdraw BEST  SCRIPT
features:
ESP & HUD
Player & drone ESP (boxes, skeleton, tracers), distance/health/name labels, item ESP, passive player tagging, customizable colors and performance modes. Also a configurable HUD with header, FPS/ping chips and crosshair options.

Aimbot & Silent Aim
Aim assist with FOV, smoothing, LOS and team filters. Silent Aim support (server-side hit redirection), prediction/lead settings, hold-to-use, and triggerbot.

Combat Utilities
No recoil renaming, fast reload (animation speed adjustments), and recoil removal toggles to make gunplay more stable and responsive.

Visuals & Camera
Fullbright (brightness, fog/shadow toggles), FOV lock, third-person camera with smoothing, and other visual helpers (hide leaves, color correction).

Exploits & Utilities
Semigod loadout spawns/equips items, auto-heal loops, Loadout button, equip scripts, and "Kill All" routines triggered from UI actions.

Movement & Anti-detection
CFrame speed movement, anti-yaw (lock/smooth/random), void-position hold mode, and ignore/whitelist UI for players.
